commands.author: Alix-007

target.title: fix(firecrawl): require own legacy provider config entries
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Firecrawl legacy web config lookup used inherited `firecrawl` properties from `tools.web.search` and `tools.web.fetch` as if they were explicit user config entries. A prototype-provided nested provider config could override the normal env/default behavior at the Firecrawl boundary.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use own-property checks for the legacy nested Firecrawl entries while preserving the existing plugin config precedence and resolver shape. The follow-up commit keeps the client-path test proof lint-clean under the same type-aware oxlint entrypoints used by CI.

## User Impact

Firecrawl only consumes legacy web config when users actually define the `firecrawl` entry on that config object. Inherited entries are ignored, so unset config falls back to the existing env/default path. Existing explicit own legacy config and plugin-owned config precedence are preserved.

## Evidence

Exact head: `c54f1b065a61645857bde0b46736eb409e1e1432`

Behavior covered by `extensions/firecrawl/src/config.own-entries.test.ts`:

- resolver-level proof for both legacy sibling surfaces: `tools.web.search.firecrawl` and `tools.web.fetch.firecrawl`;
- actual `runFirecrawlSearch` client path with inherited legacy `apiKey`/`baseUrl`, proving the request uses `https://api.firecrawl.dev/v2/search` plus `Bearer env-search-key` instead of the inherited values;
- actual `runFirecrawlScrape` client path with inherited legacy `apiKey`/`baseUrl`, proving the request uses `https://api.firecrawl.dev/v2/scrape` plus `Bearer env-fetch-key` instead of the inherited values.

Follow-up CI fix:

- CI run 29102954731 failed `check-lint` and `check-additional-extension-bundled` on the previous head because `capturedUrl = String(input)` violated type-aware oxlint `typescript(no-base-to-string)` in this test file.
- The new head captures request URLs through explicit `string` / `URL` / `Request.url` handling instead of default object stringification.

Validation run:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/firecrawl/src/config.own-entries.test.ts` (4 tests passed)
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/firecrawl/src/config.own-entries.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`
- `node scripts/run-bundled-extension-oxlint.mjs`
- `node scripts/run-oxlint-shards.mjs --threads=8`
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.extensions.test.json --incremental false --pretty false`
- `env -u OPENAI_API_KEY -u OPENAI_ORG_ID -u OPENAI_PROJECT_ID .agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` (exit 0, no findings)

Overlap note: #103492 touches the same Firecrawl files plus broader config surfaces. This PR remains the narrower Firecrawl-only patch with direct client-path regression coverage for both Firecrawl legacy surfaces.
